verdict.rationale: An AI-insights feature is a fair question for a terminal app, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a-Shell offering any built-in AI analysis, insights or suggestions about user data. Bundled Python with pip, Vim with syntax checkers, and Shortcuts automation are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
